review.assessment: This change introduces a new `solution.py` containing the `paginate` function but applies no corrections for the specified edge cases. The implementation unconditionally appends the remaining `page` list after the loop, which guarantees a stray empty page when inputs divide evenly and produces `[[]]` for empty inputs. As written, this version still contains both failure modes described in the task.

findings.defect: Stray empty page appended when items divide evenly into full pages.
Empty input list yields a single empty page instead of an empty result.
